issue_interpretation.IC0KMG_and_IC0GMS: The issue bodies are materially identical and appear to describe one grouped work item/duplicate lead. IC0KMG's 'security fix' title and its issue summary are not independent vulnerability adjudications.
issue_interpretation.independent_vulnerability_count: unknown; do not count the four listed code changes as four vulnerabilities
issue_interpretation.classification: source-level interface correctness/security-hardening changes; one externally-derived array-length validation is the only clearly security-shaped item, but exploitability and impact are not closed by the issue text

change_identity.source_retrieval: Public official Gitee clone; these commit objects and source hashes were locally read and computed. The specified bbb92db anchor was not advertised/retrievable from this remote during this research, so no claim is made that it contains this Cangjie subtree.

change_map.reported_change: CJ_GetReadPosition obtains nativeParcel_->GetReadPosition instead of GetReadableBytes
change_map.source_diff: message_sequence_impl.cpp CJ_GetReadPosition; return value changes from remaining readable bytes to absolute read cursor
change_map.family_map: No direct B-line rule-family match established. It is an API semantic correction; not shown to be a vulnerable source operation in current C++ detector scope.

change_map.reported_change: CJ_ReadRemoteObjectArray validates peer-provided arrayLength with CheckReadLength(arrayLength, BYTE_SIZE_32) before allocating/reading
change_map.source_diff: new length-gated block; error code set on failed bound. Current patch still allocates int32_t and int64_t arrays with malloc(arrayLength) byte counts, a separate concern requiring independent API/layout analysis; do not assume the patch proves safe sizing or the pre-fix exploit.
change_map.family_map: Closest conceptual analogue: DATA-02 ipc.parcel.bounds (parcel-derived length controls an allocation/read). The actual scanner B/IPC rules target C/C++ source and this change is in Cangjie binding C++; no confirmed detector eligibility, matching positive, or exploit path was established.
change_map.adjudication: single possible security candidate only; insufficient to close attacker control, resulting out-of-bounds access/impact, and fixed behavior

change_map.reported_change: CJ_ReadFloat/CJ_WriteFloat and arrays use float operations and float-sized capacity; double operations are separately implemented
change_map.source_diff: wrong double calls/size for float are corrected and float/double APIs disentangled
change_map.family_map: No direct AUTH or parcel-bounds family match. Type/serialization mismatch is plausible data integrity or protocol correctness concern, but no security consequence demonstrated.

change_map.reported_change: Cangjie IPCSkeleton getCallingUid/getCallingPid now call live OHOS::IPCSkeleton APIs; token/device/local-calling helpers also corrected
change_map.source_diff: new GetCallingPid/GetCallingUid wrappers and implementation; prior source did not expose these implementations in this file set; other helper behavior corrected
change_map.family_map: Closest possible concept: AUTH-03 ipc.auth.identity-domain/service-identity/request-identity depending on downstream misuse. No call-site authorization sink or caller-confusion exploit is in this patch evidence; rule cannot be assigned based on getter correction alone.

holdout_decision.reason: The frozen D41 manifest is preregistered with six specified repositories and pinned commits; communication_ipc is not among them. The D48 preregistration separately pins distributed_screen. This research task explicitly forbids modifying/freezing the manifest. The issues supply a grouped summary, not an independent vulnerability verdict; only the array-length item is a tentative source-level candidate and it lacks closed exploit/impact and fixed-behavior evidence. No candidate is added to the frozen holdout.
holdout_decision.maximum_candidate_count: one tentative DATA-02-like Cangjie array length hypothesis; not confirmed/reportable and not admitted
holdout_decision.labels: unknown / not adjudicated; do not count as TP, FP, FN, precision, or recall
